**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept 个月 as a monthly rate denominator**

Common monthly-rate forms using the explicit classifier `个`, such as `4000元每个月` and `4000元/个月` (and traditional `每個月`), are classified as unsupported because the captured denominator must begin directly with `月`. The otherwise equivalent `4000元每月` and `4000元/月` remain exact, so a valid candidate declared with `meaning: "rate"` and `rateUnit: "month"` loses its amount solely because of this ordinary unit spelling. Recognize the complete `个月`/`個月` alias without accepting longer words such as `月份` or `月亮`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
